law_name: Law No. 94-36 of 24 February 1994 on Literary and Artistic Property (as amended by Law No. 2009-33)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (anonymous, pseudonymous and posthumous works: 50 years from first publication)
fair_use_exceptions: Statutory exceptions (press reuse, legal proceedings, parody & pastiche)
enforcement_body: Organisme Tunisien des Droits d'Auteur et des Droits Voisins (OTDAV), under the Ministry of Cultural Affairs
